title: KSB ticks and Practical camera fix
details: Course coverage now shows exactly one yellow learner-evidence tick
A covered KSB shows at most one additional external-source tick: purple RPL, otherwise blue assessor observation, otherwise orange witness testimony
Old dot, circle and duplicate tick elements are removed from each KSB tile before the correct source ticks are rebuilt
Mock Practical Camera now switches to image-only rear-camera capture before Android opens it, while Gallery remains separate
Discussion remains Mock Discussion only and Practical remains Mock Practical only
Maths Level 2 and English Level 2 remain directly under Practical in Test/ARP
summary: Evia v210 removes the remaining duplicate KSB markers shown on Course coverage and corrects the Android Mock Practical Camera route so Camera no longer uses the mixed image/video gallery picker.
changes: Strengthened KSB marker cleanup at source
Limited KSB display to one learner tick plus one external-source tick
Added direct Android camera routing without a MutationObserver
Created a clean v210 offline cache so old marker and camera behaviour is replaced
